gates.name: Test the host
gates.reason: dotnet test src/host/SubZeroDev.GameEngine.Host.Tests/SubZeroDev.GameEngine.Host.Tests.csproj requires restoring SubZeroDev.Platform.Hosting from the SubZeroDev.Platform repository's GitHub Packages feed. src/host/nuget.config expands %NUGET_GITHUB_ACTOR% and %NUGET_GITHUB_TOKEN% from the environment for that source, and neither is set in this session (echo of NUGET_GITHUB_TOKEN was empty). CI supplies this from the REGISTRY_TOKEN secret; running dotnet test without it would fail restore with an opaque, non-representative error rather than exercising the host's own tests. The corresponding CI check is the 'smoke' job in host-image.yml on the pull request.

gates.name: Positive route and probe smoke
gates.reason: This step builds the host Docker image, which restores SubZeroDev.Platform.Hosting from GitHub Packages using build secrets nuget_github_token derived from the REGISTRY_TOKEN CI secret (host-image.yml). That token is not available in this session, so the image build (and therefore the container run and curl probes) cannot be reproduced locally. The corresponding CI check is the 'smoke' job in host-image.yml on the pull request.

gates.name: Negative fixture -- corrupted artifact must fail to start
gates.reason: This step builds tools/host-smoke/Dockerfile.negative-fixture on top of the base image built in the prior 'Build the image' step, which itself requires the REGISTRY_TOKEN-backed cross-repo NuGet restore that is unavailable in this session (see 'Positive route and probe smoke'). No base image exists locally to build the negative fixture from. The corresponding CI check is the 'smoke' job in host-image.yml on the pull request.
